title: Linguistic Trajectory Encoding for Efficient Long-Horizon Spatial Memory in Embodied Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.04802v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Embodied agents performing long-horizon tasks require a memory representation in which the state transitions of dynamic objects remain queryable in natural language across hours-to-days observation horizons. Existing systems either drop fine-grained motion (clip-level video-language embeddings), keep it only as raw coordinates (geometric SLAM), or organise it around immediate task context (agent working memories). None of them gives the agent a per-object timeline whose state transitions are themselves queryable in language. Our key contribution is \textbf{Linguistic Trajectory Encoding} (LTE), which compresses dynamic object motion histories via a hybrid representation combining natural language descriptions, sparse spatial anchors, and visual anchors. translated_title: 面向具身智能体高效长时程空间记忆的语言轨迹编码
translated_abstract: 执行长时程任务的具身智能体需要一种记忆表示，使动态物体的状态转移在数小时至数天的观测范围内仍能通过自然语言进行查询。现有系统要么丢弃细粒度运动信息（片段级视频-语言嵌入），要么仅以原始坐标形式保留运动（几何SLAM），要么围绕即时任务上下文组织信息（智能体工作记忆）。它们都无法为智能体提供一种按物体划分的时间线，使状态转移本身可以用语言查询。我们的核心贡献是语言轨迹编码，它通过结合自然语言描述、稀疏空间锚点和视觉锚点的混合表示来压缩动态物体的运动历史。LTE根据运动复杂度自适应调整压缩方式：将缺乏可靠观测的时段锚定在最后被观测到的位置，同时用几何路径点和语言描述来表征运动（摘要不完整，此处为截断部分）。
tldr: 提出语言轨迹编码，通过结合自然语言描述、稀疏空间锚点和视觉锚点的混合表示压缩动态物体运动历史，使具身智能体在长时程任务中能够用自然语言查询动态物体的状态转移。
en_tdlr: Proposes Linguistic Trajectory Encoding (LTE), which compresses dynamic object motion histories via a hybrid representation of natural language descriptions, sparse spatial anchors, and visual anchors, enabling embodied agents to query state transitions of dynamic objects in natural language over long-horizon tasks.
